submission.justification: Recommend Radiator-R3 at 2.65 cm as the performance-optimal provisional design. In the simulation scan/refinement it gives the best pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c: 4.946 sigma, exceeding the best found for Radiator-R1 by 0.972 sigma and Radiator-R2 by 1.963 sigma. The thickness is within the allowed 1–6 cm range. However, the recorded document extraction found no numeric humidity-ageing transparency-loss values for any candidate, so the 10% hard ageing requirement is not strictly verified from the available results; no candidate can be confirmed compliant on that requirement based on the recorded data.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: Best recorded separation is Radiator-R3 at 2.65 cm with 4.946 sigma; best alternatives are Radiator-R1 at 2.75 cm with 3.974 sigma and Radiator-R2 at 3 cm with 2.983 sigma.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Selected option is Radiator-R3, one of the three allowed candidates Radiator-R1, Radiator-R2, and Radiator-R3.

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after a 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%.
requirements.evidence: Recorded results show ageing_numeric_loss_values_found_count = 0, humidity_loss_values_found_count = 0, ageing_data_missing_flag = 1, and strict_ageing_verified_Radiator_R3 = 0. No candidate was numerically verified against the 10% threshold.
Selected thickness is 2.65 cm, within the allowed 1–6 cm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.
